sloka: लक्ष्मणः च अपि तत्र एव विहाय वसने शुभे ।तापसाच् चादने चैव जग्राह पितुर् अग्रतः ॥२-३७-८॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ ca api tatra eva vihāya vasane śubhe ।tāpasāc cādane caiva jagrāha pitur agrataḥ ॥2-37-8॥

translations.english: Lakshmana also removed his auspicious raiment in front (presence) of his father and accepted (put on) the robes of an ascetic.
